manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} reduced by {1} for each initial peace counter
description:
At the beginning of combat, Peace in Our Time triggers, causing you to draw a card and put a peace counter on it.
During your second main phase, cast Expansion Algorithm by paying {X}{U}{U} (where X is twelve minus the number of peace counters on Peace in Our Time), causing you to proliferate those counters X times.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Peace in Our Time triggers, causing you to win the game.
